title: Throughput Validation — Engineering Plan vs. Architecture Targets
purpose: Validates that the S203 engineering plan preserves all S202 throughput targets. Cross-checks each BF metric against the engineering specifications to confirm the implementation plan supports (not undermines) the architecture projections.
validation_methodology: Each BF metric from the S202 throughput model is cross-checked against the S203 engineering specifications to verify: (a) the metric is measurable by the defined engines, (b) the engine architecture supports achieving the target, (c) no engineering decision contradicts or weakens the throughput projection.

board_count_target.s203_engineering_support: CONFIRMED. All boards have corresponding engines: Identity/Registry engines (Board A), Scan/Quality/Readiness engines (Boards B-C), Governance Board via governance guard + readiness engine, Certification Board via certification operations console, Throughput tracked via BF metrics in readiness report.

agent_reduction_target.s202_projection: -74% reduction via pre-flight + delta + board consolidation
agent_reduction_target.s203_engineering_support: CONFIRMED. Pre-flight eliminates scan-only agents (89.5% of items clean before board). Delta skips 80% of items. Single-pass quality board replaces 6 v1 boards. Expected agent count: 1 orchestrator + 1-2 scan agents + 2 quality agents + 1 certification agent + 1 governance agent = ~6-7.
agent_reduction_target.risk: LOW — agent count depends on defect load, which pre-flight directly controls

report_reduction_target.s203_engineering_support: CONFIRMED. Reporting Engine produces exactly 4: Readiness, Quality, Certification, Governance. Agent outputs embedded as board verdicts, not standalone files. Legacy retirement plan covers ~800 files.
report_reduction_target.risk: NONE — engineering architecture produces exactly 4 core reports

readiness_failure_target.s203_engineering_support: CONFIRMED. Readiness Engine gates items automatically: Gate -1 (identity) → Gate 0 (JSON) → Gate 1 (DL-008/026/016) → Gate 2 (DL-013/EV3/DL-010) → Gate 3 (compound-key) → Gate 4 (DL-030/031). Only READY items visible to boards. Remediate/BLOCKED items invisible.
readiness_failure_target.validation: Engineering plan includes all 11 mandatory scans. Pre-flight runtime ~51s for all packs. Readiness classification is deterministic per item. Board visibility rules enforce REMEDIATE/BLOCKED items hidden from Quality/Certification boards.
readiness_failure_target.risk: LOW — depends on scan stability and identity resolution. Both validated by within-object AM-1 extraction.

duplicate_review_target.s203_engineering_support: CONFIRMED. Scan Engine produces artifacts once per session. All boards consume same artifacts. Delta Review skips 80% of items. EW fields examined by at most 2 agents (Quality A+B). In v1, EW fields were examined by 4-7 agents per session.
duplicate_review_target.risk: LOW — scan-once/consume-many enforced by orchestrator architecture

re_review_rate_target.s203_engineering_support: CONFIRMED. Delta Review Engine computes content_hash per item. DELTA_LEDGER stores baselines. 5 inheritance rules (IR-001 through IR-005) handle all change types. Unchanged items skip review entirely (IR-001: CertifiedDelta). EW-only changes get targeted review (IR-002). Conservative override catches new scan findings on unchanged items (IR-005).
re_review_rate_target.validation: Per-100-items: 80 unchanged → skip (0 min), 10 EW-only → 2 min each (20 min), 3 EC-only → 3 min (9 min), 4 metadata → 2 min (8 min), 3 full-content → 8 min (24 min). Total: 61 min. v1: 600 min. -90%.
re_review_rate_target.risk: LOW-MEDIUM — hash stability across sessions requires validation. Canonical serialization must be deterministic.

throughput_multiplier_target.s203_engineering_support: CONFIRMED. Engineering plan allocates: pre-flight ~1 min (automated), per-item quality review: 2-3 min (down from 6-7 min v1), certification adjudication: 0.5 min/item. With delta review skipping 80%: per-wave 100 items → 20 reviewed × 3 min = 60 min quality + 10 min certification + 1 min pre-flight = ~71 min. ~84 items/hr. Supports Phase 2 target of 8-12/hr.
throughput_multiplier_target.validation: Phase 3 with full automation: 135 items/wave × 80% skip → 27 reviewed × 2 min = 54 min + 5 min cert + 1 min scan = 60 min. 27/hr reviewed; 135/hr total throughput. Supports 3.8× multiplier.
throughput_multiplier_target.risk: LOW — throughput gains are architectural, not aspirational. Pre-flight automation + delta skipping are the key drivers.

cost_reduction_target.target: 70% cost reduction per certified item (0.305 → 0.092 agent-spawns)
cost_reduction_target.s203_engineering_support: CONFIRMED. Per-wave 100 items: v1 = 4-5 sessions × 15-28 agents = 60-140 spawns. v2 = 1-2 sessions × 6-7 agents = 6-14 spawns. 0.06-0.14 spawns/item. Supports target.
cost_reduction_target.risk: LOW — agent count directly reduced by pre-flight + board consolidation

identity_ambiguity_target.s202_projection: Compound-key identity + Gate -1 + AM-1 within-object extraction
identity_ambiguity_target.s203_engineering_support: CONFIRMED. Identity Engine resolves compound keys: QID+CC+EWP+TF+FP+VID. Gate -1 validates identity before any downstream scan. AM-1 within-object extraction is the ONLY approved methodology. Forward-scan, QID-only, and regex-window are all forbidden (FM-001 through FM-008). Governance guard Rules 9-10 enforce at HARD_BLOCK level.
identity_ambiguity_target.validation: Engineering plan includes: (1) identity migration of all 2,500 items, (2) identity_key stability verification across 2 independent AM-1 passes, (3) backward-compat shim for QID-only tools during transition.
identity_ambiguity_target.risk: NONE — compound-key architecture is fully specified with verifiable test gates

overall_throughput_validation.verdict: PRESERVED. All 8 S202 throughput targets are supported by S203 engineering specifications.
overall_throughput_validation.discrepancies: NONE. No S203 engineering decision contradicts or weakens any S202 throughput projection.
overall_throughput_validation.enhancements: Recommendation Pipeline (Board E) and Administration Portal (Board G) are new capabilities not in S202 throughput model. These add operational efficiency but do not change the certification throughput targets.
overall_throughput_validation.projected_break_even: ~254 items certified (~mid-Phase 2, ~3.5 weeks after S830). Unchanged from S202 projection.
